title: Sage sausage patties with roast squash and red cabbage slaw

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Sausages, squash, cabbage, apples, vinegar and mustard are all ordinary kitchen staples with nothing factory-made beyond good sausages.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: Two roasting trays, a bowl and a knife, with no technique beyond squeezing sausages from skins.

works.reason: Squash wedges at 220°C for 30 minutes and sausage patties for 20 minutes will both cook through, and eight sausages plus a large squash and slaw feeds four.

honest_times.reason: Seeding and wedging the squash, skinning and shaping the sausages and shredding the slaw fits roughly 18 active minutes, and the 30-minute cook matches the roasting step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the sage and chilli, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roast squash wedges are a main part of the plate rather than a garnish, and a warm roast dinner with apple slaw suits early September.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, British and easy for a beginner to follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Sausage, roast squash and a fresh cabbage and apple slaw make a balanced family dinner.
